MACRO inner FOO,BAR
 LUA ALLPASS
 assert(sj.get_define('FOO', true) == 'arg1')
 assert(sj.get_define('FOO', false) == 'abcd')
 assert(sj.get_define('FOO') == 'abcd')
 assert(sj.get_define('BAR', true) == 'arg2')
 assert(sj.get_define('BAR', false) == nil)
 assert(sj.get_define('BAZ', true) == 'efgh')
 sj.add_byte(7)
 ENDLUA
 ENDM
 MACRO outer FOO
 inner arg1,arg2
 LUA ALLPASS
 assert(sj.get_define('FOO', true) == 'outerarg')
 sj.add_byte(9)
 ENDLUA
 ENDM
 DEFINE FOO abcd
 DEFINE BAZ efgh
 outer outerarg
 LUA ALLPASS
 assert(sj.get_define('FOO', true) == 'abcd')
 assert(sj.get_define('BAR', true) == nil)
 ENDLUA

LUA PASS1
 sj.insert_label('value', 23)
 ENDLUA
 db value

MODULE one
 LUA ALLPASS
 assert(sj.get_modules() == 'one')
 assert(sj.insert_label('start', 3))
 assert(sj.insert_label('.local', 4))
 assert(sj.get_label('.local') == 4)
 sj.add_byte(_c('start + .local'))
 ENDLUA
 ENDMODULE
 db one.start,one.start.local

device zxspectrum128
 org $c000
 LUA ALLPASS
 assert(sj.set_slot(0xc000))
 assert(sj.set_page(6))
 sj.add_byte(42)
 assert(sj.set_page(7))
 _pc('org $c000')
 sj.add_byte(99)
 ENDLUA
 LUA
 assert(sj.get_byte(0xc000) == 99)
 assert(sj.set_page(6))
 sj.add_byte(sj.get_byte(0xc000))
 ENDLUA

DUP 2
 LUA ALLPASS
 sj.add_byte(7)
 ENDLUA
 EDUP

MACRO emit
 LUA ALLPASS
 sj.add_byte(9)
 ENDLUA
 ENDM
 emit
 emit

device zxspectrum48
 org $8000
 LUA PASS1
 count = 1; saved = sj.add_byte
 ENDLUA
 LUA PASS2
 count = count + 1
 ENDLUA
 LUA ALLPASS
 _pl('start: ld a,7')
 assert(sj.current_address == 0x8002)
 sj.add_byte(sj.get_label('start') % 256)
 ENDLUA
 LUA PASS3
 saved(count)
 sj.add_byte(sj.get_byte(0x8001))
 ENDLUA

LUA ALLPASS
 n = (n or 0) + 1
 sj.add_byte(n)
 ENDLUA

IF 0
 LUA
 error('unreachable')
 ENDLUA
 ENDIF
 db 42

LUA ALLPASS
 local s = 'a;b:c//d'
 sj.add_byte(#s)
 sj.add_byte(('abc'):byte(2))
 ENDLUA

LUA ALLPASS
 assert(sj.insert_define('V', '7'))
 assert(not sj.insert_define('V', '8'))
 assert(sj.get_define('V') == '8')
 assert(sj.insert_label('foo', 12))
 sj.add_word(_c('foo + V'))
 ENDLUA
 db foo,V

LUA ALLPASS
 sj.add_byte(_c('later'))
 ENDLUA
later: db 42

device zxspectrum48
 org $8000
 db 23
 LUA
 assert(sj.get_byte(0x8000) == 23)
 sj.add_byte(sj.get_byte(0x8000))
 _pc('org $8000')
 sj.add_byte(99)
 assert(sj.get_byte(0x8000) == 99)
 ENDLUA

; Sinus table generator - using lua script, because sjasmplus itself does not have
    ; floating point arithmetics and sin/cos/... functions.

    org $8000

sin_table:  ; check listing file to see resulting table bytes
    lua allpass ; EVERY pass must emit the machine code to not affect following labels
        -- 256 bytes (index 0..255):
        for i = 0, 255, 1 do

            -- index 0..255 will cover angle range < 0, 2Pi )
            -- i.e. going in sinus values 0 -> +1 -> 0 -> -1 -> 0
            -- For different range, the /128.0 must be modified:
            --     /256.0 is 0..Pi, /512.0 is 0..Pi/2, etc

            -- The *15.5 is amplitude of final values
            -- to be -15 .. +15 (+0.5 for "floor" compensation)
            -- in this example values are signed byte (-15 == 241 == 0xF1)

            sj.add_byte(math.floor(math.sin(math.pi * i / 128.0) * 15.5))
        end
    endlua

    jr  start
